question: Should successful plugin interactive handlers have a durable public `submitText` contract that supporting channels may route into the originating inbound agent conversation?
rationale: The implementation is additive and behaviorally proven, but it changes the public plugin contract from a Telegram-specific result to a cross-channel capability and can activate previously ignored Discord handler output.

options.title: Approve the shared contract
options.body: Keep the exported shared result type and Discord routing behavior as the supported cross-channel plugin API, with the updated SDK documentation as its contract.

options.title: Keep submission transport-specific
options.body: Retain or redesign the behavior as a Discord-specific API so generic plugin handler results cannot implicitly gain new channel semantics.

options.title: Pause for broader channel design
options.body: Defer merge until owners define which channels may support inbound text submission and their required retry and authorization guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exported shared result type and Discord routing behavior as the supported cross-channel plugin API, with the updated SDK documentation as its contract.

likelyOwner.reason: No person-level current-main ownership trail was available in the supplied review evidence; the decision belongs with the responsible plugin-SDK owner.
